theater: 靈州黃河西岸至陰山南麓

battle.name: 楊素擊突厥之戰
battle.theater: 靈州黃河西岸至陰山南麓
battle.brief: 仁壽二年（602）冬，東突厥越塞攻靈州，隋文帝以尚書右僕射楊素為行軍元帥率步騎出靈州，與騎兵相持於黃河西岸，追奔至長城以北的斤兩，斬獲數萬，諸部內附。卡面那件希臘重步兵屬公元前五世紀，與隋軍無涉；「遮蔽」有兩種做法：希臘人靠人挨人成方陣，隋朝靠靈州城與屯田，把遮蔽由縱深改成壁壘。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 交戰的兩方是隋朝與東突厥汗庭。隋文帝楊堅在開皇末年已基本平定北方，南滅陳、北逐突厥之後，把河西與河套一線的安危視為國本，邊防由尚書省與行臺總管府系統運作，靈州、鹽州、朔方、秦州、蘭州各置軍鎮，鎮下設長史、司馬、參軍，主官多以寒門出身、歷練軍旅的將領充任，尚書右僕射楊素是其中的樞紐人物。突厥方面，此時牙帳仍在漠北，控弦之眾分佈在陰山、狼山、賀蘭山與河套以北的草場，帳下有左右賢王與處羅侯、俟利苾等分部首領，名義上的可汗由都藍可汗之弟處羅侯接任，內部則被頡利與俟利苾兩股勢力分占，號令並不完全一致。隋朝對突厥的策略是邊防與離間並用：一面以重兵守住靈州與塞北長城線，一面封賞鐵勒、吐谷渾等曾受突厥壓迫的部族，令其改附，削弱汗庭的外圍。開皇十九年（599）、開皇二十年（600）與仁壽二年（602）的幾次出兵，都建立在這種邊軍集結、內應外合的格局上。
countriesEn: The two parties were the Sui dynasty and the court of the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. By the end of the Kaihuang era Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, had essentially settled the north: after destroying Chen in the south and driving the Turks back in the north, he held the safety of the Hexi corridor and the Hetao plain to be a foundation of the state. Frontier administration ran through the Department of State Affairs and the offices of the circuit intendants, with military towns at Lingzhou, Yanzhou, Shuofang, Qinzhou and Lanzhou, each staffed by a chief clerk, a military adjutant and a staff officer. The men who held these posts were usually generals of humble family who had risen through actual service, and among them the right assistant secretary of state Yang Su was the pivot. On the Turkic side the yurt of the khagan still stood north of the desert, with its mounted archers spread over the pastures beyond the Yin Mountains, the Lang Mountains, the Helan range and the Hetao plain. Below the khagan sat the left and right wise-kings and the leaders of separate divisions such as Chuluo Hou and Shili. The titular khan was Chuluo Hou, the brother of the late Dulan Khan, while inside the khanate the factions of Jieli and Shili divided the power, so that orders did not always carry alike throughout. Sui policy towards the Turks combined defence with diplomatic division. On one side heavy troops held Lingzhou and the wall line on the northern frontier; on the other the court bestowed titles and rewards upon the Tiele, the Tuyuhun and other peoples who had long been oppressed by the Turks, turning them away from the khanate and stripping it of its auxiliaries. The campaigns of 599, 600 and 602 all rested on that pattern: frontier armies concentrated, and allies outside the wall pulling in the same direction.
people: 核心人物是楊素。此人出身寒微，早年以文武材幹起家，開皇年間歷任荊州、揚州總管，滅陳之役為主力統帥，軍紀嚴整而每戰身先士卒，隋平江南的功業大半繫於他一身；開皇十九年以後以尚書右僕射總制北伐諸軍，於突厥邊戰中再被推到台前。文帝楊堅在每次出動前下詔指定元帥、行軍路線與日期，戰後按斬獲論功行賞，楊素因此進封楚國公、位至尚書右僕射與上柱國，權柄與勳名同時膨脹。衛王楊爽是楊堅之弟，開皇二年（582）已率諸軍三十餘萬出靈州大破突厥，是楊素之後北伐的樣板；長孫晟則是此役背後的謀主，主張分兵以疑敵之勢、選精騎夜襲敵營，然後全軍壓上，並在對鐵勒等部的外交上主張遠交而近攻，把外圍的部族先拉過來，使汗庭失去徵發的依賴。突厥一側，處羅侯可汗在位而大權旁落，俟利苾領一部，鐵勒諸部首領俟斤等亦觀望；雙方勝負，有相當一部分是在帳外談成的。
peopleEn: The central figure was Yang Su. Born into a poor family, he had risen as a man of parts in both civil and military service, and in the Kaihuang era he served as circuit intendant of Jingzhou and then of Yangzhou. As the commander who carried the war against Chen, he was known for strict discipline and for leading from the front, and the Sui conquest of the south rested largely on his shoulders. After 599 he was appointed right assistant secretary of state to direct the northern armies, and the Turkic war brought him back to the centre of affairs. Emperor Wen issued the edicts that named the commander-in-chief, fixed the route and the date of departure, and after each campaign rewarded the army according to the numbers taken; Yang Su's ennoblement as Duke of Chu and his standing among the highest military offices of the empire grew together with his record. Prince Wei Yang Shuang, the emperor's brother, had already led more than three hundred thousand men out of Lingzhou in 582 and routed the Turks, and he was the precedent Yang Su followed. Changsun Sheng was the strategist behind these operations, arguing for splitting the enemy by feints, for sending picked cavalry to strike the camp by night, and only then committing the whole army, and in his dealings with the Tiele and other peoples he held to a policy of making distant allies and pressing near enemies, drawing the peripheral tribes away from the khanate before the khanate could conscript them. On the Turkic side, Khagan Chuluo Hou held the title but not the power, Shili led a division of his own, and tribal leaders of the Tiele such as Xiejin watched and waited. A good part of how this war was decided was settled in those councils outside the camp.
kits: 本卡所屬的希臘重步兵，成軍於公元前五世紀的希臘城邦，裝備是科林斯式青銅頭盔、蒙住整條右臂與大部分軀幹的圓盾、兩米多長的刺槊，配亞麻背心上的青銅鱗甲或青銅胸甲，再加雙刃短劍；他們以密集的縱深方陣作戰，前排以盾遮身、槍尖越肩伸出，形成一堵可以整體移動的活牆。這套東西在公元六百零二年的長安、靈州、漠北都找不到，與突厥之間更沒有任何技術或編制上的血緣關係；希臘重步兵在羅馬帝國晚期已經退場，本卡落到這場戰役，是作為密集重步兵這一兵種範式的對照物。真正出現在靈州戰場的是隋軍裝備：步兵戴明光鎧、配鍪與兜鍪，長槊與橫刀分列兩端，弓弩（其中蹶張弩與大弩供城頭及伏兵使用）覆蓋射界，騎兵配馬鐙、馬鎔具與較輕的皮甲，後勤靠牛車與駱駝馱運糧秣，攻城則備雲梯、巢車、擲車與飛石。突厥一側是另一套：騎兵不著重甲，披皮袍與小片革甲，佩彎弓骨鏃、長矛短刀，帳幕用氈，鼓角齊整，甲士與輕騎分編。值得再對照一處：希臘人的「互相遮蔽」靠人挨人，隋朝的「互相遮蔽」靠靈州城垣、長城與屯田——遮蔽的載體由軍隊縱深改成了壁壘與糧秣線。兩套體系相撞，重點不在單件兵器的銳利，而在防具承重、馬匹恢復與糧秣供應。
kitsEn: The kit on this card, the Greek hoplite, was formed in the fifth century BCE among the Greek city-states. Its equipment was a Corinthian bronze helmet, a round shield covering the whole right arm and most of the torso, a thrusting spear more than two metres long, a bronze corselet or scale armour worn over a linen backing, and a double-edged short sword. They fought in dense, deep phalanxes, the front rank sheltering behind the shields with the spear-points projecting over the shoulder, so that a body of men moved as one living wall. None of that could be found in the Chang'an, Lingzhou or steppe of AD 602, and there was no technical or institutional link whatever between hoplites and Turks. The Greek heavy infantry had already left the field by the late Roman empire, and this card sits in the campaign only as a reference for what a dense heavy infantry arm actually looks like. What stood on the field at Lingzhou was the Sui equipment: infantry in bright-plated armour with helmets and neck guards, long spears and cross-swords at the two ends of the line, bows and crossbows — the strong lever and the heavy crossbow serving the walls and the ambush parties — covering the field of fire, and mounted troops with stirrups, harness and lighter leather armour. The rear echelon depended on ox-carts and camels to carry grain and fodder, and the siege train held ladders, siege towers, stone-throwers and missiles. The Turks carried a different set: riders in no heavy armour but sheepskin coats and small pieces of leather, with composite bows, bone-tipped arrows, long spears and short knives, tents of felt, drums and horns, the armoured and the light horse kept in separate lists. One further contrast is worth making: what the Greeks meant by mutual cover was men standing shoulder to shoulder, whereas what the Sui meant by it was the wall of Lingzhou, the frontier wall and the garrison farms — the thing that shelters the army is no longer the depth of the formation but the fortification and the grain line. When the two systems met, the issue was not the edge of any single weapon but the load-bearing of armour, the recovery of the horses and the supply of grain.
tactics: 隋軍在北邊的作戰思路可以概括成一句話：以密集步陣頂住騎兵，以精騎割斷敵人的糧道與退路，再以城與屯田把邊界固定下來。開皇二年（582）出靈州時，楊爽為行軍元帥，楊素佐之，長孫晟獻策，主張分兵以疑敵之勢、選精騎夜襲其營，然後全軍壓上；這套分兵、夜襲、合擊的路數在靈州一線反覆使用。這與希臘重步兵對付波斯輕騎的老經驗是同一個方向：不與騎兵比速度，而是靠方陣的厚度、盾牌的連續與縱深，把衝鋒的勢能吃掉；馬其頓人後來用亞歷山大的騎兵從側翼反擊破掉波斯方陣，隋將在草原上也明白同一個道理，所以留下重騎與精騎的同時，強調不要讓主隊與游騎脫節。具體部署上，隋軍以靈州為前進基地，兵分一路正面壓迫，另一路沿黃河與山道插向敵後，斷其牧場與水源；追擊階段不超過草原縱深，避免被引誘散開；糧車隊列走在中部，兩翼以騎兵遮護，並依靠長城沿線的烽燧亭障維持通訊。冬季是突厥馬力最弱、草場枯黃的時節，隋軍一般於秋末發兵、初春班師，行程與補給都按這個節奏安排。隋軍並未帶著密集隊形長驅漠北：方陣需要密集人力與糧秣才能站穩，草原上只能維持一段，越過長城之後便要靠城池撐住，所以追到斤兩即收兵，把遮蔽由流動的隊形換成固定的城與屯田。
tacticsEn: The Sui method in the north can be put in one line: hold the horse with a dense infantry formation, cut the enemy's supply line and retreat with picked cavalry, and fix the frontier with towns and garrison farms. When the army marched out of Lingzhou in 582, Yang Shuang was commander-in-chief with Yang Su in support, and Changsun Sheng proposed splitting the force to make the enemy doubt his lines, sending picked cavalry to strike the camp by night, and only then committing the whole army; the sequence of feint, night attack and convergence was used again and again on the Lingzhou line. This is the same direction as the old Greek answer to Persian light horse: do not compete with the horse in speed, but use the thickness of the phalanx, the continuity of the shields and the depth of the ranks to absorb the shock of the charge. The Macedonians later broke the Persian phalanx with Alexander's cavalry striking the flank, and the Sui commanders understood the same point on the steppe: they kept heavy horse and picked cavalry in being while insisting that the main body never lose contact with the patrols. In deployment, Lingzhou served as the forward base. One force pressed the enemy in front, another pushed along the Yellow River and the mountain tracks to fall behind him and cut his pastures and his water. The pursuit was kept within a limited depth of the grassland so as not to be lured into dispersal; the baggage train stayed in the centre with the flanks screened by cavalry, and communications ran through the beacon towers and barrier forts along the wall line. Winter was the season when Turkic horses were weakest and the pasture yellow; Sui armies normally marched out in the last months of autumn and returned in early spring, and both the length of the march and the size of the loads were planned to that rhythm. The Sui did not carry a dense formation deep into the desert: a phalanx needs mass and grain to hold together, and on the grassland it can be kept together only for a stretch, while beyond the wall the towns must carry the weight instead. That is why the pursuit was called off at Jinliang, and the shelter moved from a moving formation to fixed towns and garrison farms.
data: 關於兵力數字，史書的記載要打折扣看。開皇二年那一次，《隋書》記衛王楊爽率諸軍三十餘萬出靈州，數字顯然含有誇大，但仍可作為隋朝一次大規模北伐的規模上限參考。仁壽二年（602）這次北伐的兵數，兩《隋書》與《資治通鑑》都沒有留下明確總數，一般只在率諸軍、大將眾十餘萬一類模糊語句裏，保守說法是步騎合計以數萬計，連同沿邊軍鎮與運糧丁夫在內達數十萬之眾。斬首與俘虜的數字，史料多作數萬、萬餘，如開皇二十年追擊戰後的追亡逐北與大量降附，附帶的牛羊駱駝以萬計；這類數目包含被擄走的部眾與牲畜，難以核對。距離與時間方面，靈州到陰山南麓的正面戰線約四五百里，追擊最遠的一段又被記為數百里乃至千里，隋軍往來一趟常以月計。物資是硬限制：出塞作戰最怕斷糧，糧車與駱駝隊的規模決定了戰役能推多遠，兵部尚書的調度與民戶的轉輸因此比戰術更吃重。同期修築的隋長城一段，西起黃河上游靈州附近，東接既有的秦漢舊塞，綿延以千里計，役使來自河北冀州、並州等地丁夫，徵發以萬計。這些數字都是概數，不宜當作精確統計。
dataEn: The figures for troops in the sources have to be taken with a discount. For the campaign of 582 the Book of Sui records that Prince of Wei Yang Shuang led more than three hundred thousand men out of Lingzhou. The figure is plainly inflated, but it remains a useful upper bound for the scale of a major Sui northern expedition. For the campaign of 602 neither the Book of Sui nor the Comprehensive Mirror gives a definite total; the language is vague — leading the various armies, some hundred thousand of the greater sort — and the safest statement is that foot and horse together numbered in the tens of thousands, rising to hundreds of thousands if the frontier garrisons and the men transporting grain are counted. The figures for killed and captured are mostly given as several tens of thousands or some ten thousand, as when the pursuit of 600 is described as racing the fleeing and gathering a great many of the surrendered, with the cattle, sheep and camels that went with them counted in ten thousands. Such numbers include deported communities and livestock and cannot be checked. As for distance and time, the front line from Lingzhou to the southern foot of the Yin Mountains is some four to five hundred li, the longest recorded stage of the pursuit several hundred li and in places a thousand, and a round trip was measured in months. Supply was the hard limit: a campaign in the steppe dies if the grain line breaks, so the size of the baggage carts and camel trains decided how far the army could push, and the logistics of the Department of War and the local transport convoys weighed more than tactics. The stretch of Sui wall built at the same time ran from near Lingzhou on the upper Yellow River eastwards to join the old Qin and Han ramparts, a line of about a thousand li, raised by corvée from households in Hebei and Bingzhou, the labour levy counted in ten thousands. All of these are round numbers and should not be read as precise statistics.
cause: 打起來的直接原因是東突厥再次南下越塞。仁壽二年（602），處羅侯一系的突厥重新集結，進攻靈州、鹽州、五原一線，殺傷邊民、掠走人畜與馬匹；此前開皇十九年（599）與開皇二十年（600）也各有一次大規模入寇，隋朝每次都不得不把北方主力重新拉回塞北。深一層的原因是力量對比改變：隋在滅陳之後已把南、北兩面的戰爭都收束，聲勢壓向漠北，鐵勒、吐谷渾、俟利苾等原本附庸於突厥的部族開始觀望甚至倒向，牙庭在都藍之死後的兩次爭立中消耗了大量人馬，汗庭用大規模入寇來搶奪邊地物資、扭轉附庸流失，是能用的少數辦法之一。邊境還有另一層麻煩：隋朝邊地長期戰亂留下大量流亡與叛附者，突厥每次南下都能在內地得到嚮導與接應，隋廷因此把突厥視為比高句麗更急迫的威脅。與此同時，隋文帝需要一場乾淨的邊境勝利來鞏固開皇末年的局面，而楊素在滅陳之後久未再有大功，北方戰線正是給他的位置。
causeEn: The immediate reason the war was fought was that the Eastern Turks came over the frontier again. In 602 the Turks of the Chuluo Hou line massed once more and struck Lingzhou, Yanzhou and Wuyuan, killing the frontier population and carrying off people, livestock and horses. There had been large incursions in 599 and in 600 as well, and each time the Sui had to pull its northern field army back to the steppe. Deeper down, the balance of power had shifted. With the war against Chen closed, the Sui could apply pressure on both fronts, and the Tiele, the Tuyuhun and Shili, formerly tributaries of the Turks, began to hesitate and even to turn away. The khanate had lost men and horses in the struggles over the khanship that followed the death of Dulan, so a large raid was one of the few means left to seize goods from the border and to reverse the drift of the tributaries. There was a further complication on the frontier: the long wars had left a great many people in flight and in rebellion, and every Turkic incursion found guides and receivers inside the empire, so the court came to treat the Turks as a more urgent threat than Goguryeo. At the same time Emperor Wen needed a clean victory on the northern front to shore up the late Kaihuang order, and Yang Su, who had won no great campaign since the conquest of Chen, was given the place that belonged to him.
impact: 這場戰爭的直接後果是靈州一線歸於安寧，隋朝得以把邊防從以戰守城改為以城屯田，修築隋長城、增置軍鎮、移民實邊，靈州從一個臨時軍營變成西北軍事的樞紐，後來唐代在此設靈州都督府與河西節度，一脉相承。更遠的影響在北亞：東突厥在隋的持續壓力與內部政變中耗盡元氣，汗庭西遷、附庸崩解，最終在貞觀四年（630）隨頡利可汗的敗亡而解體，隋朝邊軍在靈州、朔方、定襄一線的經營，實際上替唐初收拾北邊留下了骨架。國內政治上，楊素靠北方軍功坐大，進封楚國公、常侍禁中，卻也因頻有平陳北伐之功而捲入太子勇與晉王廣之間的暗鬥，最終站在楊廣一邊，客觀上推動了皇位繼承的傾斜，五年後他死在大業二年（606），隋廷的軍功集團也隨之瓦解。還有代價要記：長城與丁役的徵發加重了河北民戶的負擔，開皇末年役繁民困的怨聲正在累積，成為隋末民變的遠因之一。此外，六世紀的戰爭形態在這場戰役中定了型：步兵仍是決定性的力量，騎兵負責機動、追擊與斷糧，隋唐重裝騎兵的全面化還要再等一百多年才出現。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that the Lingzhou line was secured, and the Sui could change frontier defence from fighting to holding towns and farming them: the wall was built, more military towns were set up, and families were moved to the border. Lingzhou changed from a temporary camp into the pivot of northwestern defence, the line that later carried the Lingzhou dudufu and the Hexi jiedushi under the Tang. Further afield in northern Asia the Eastern Turkic khanate lost its strength under sustained Sui pressure and internal coups; the court moved west, its tributaries broke away, and the structure finally came apart when the Tang took Jieli Khan in the fourth year of Zhenguan, 630, so the Sui work at Lingzhou, Shuofang and Dingxiang left the skeleton that the early Tang inherited. In domestic politics Yang Su grew on the credit of northern victory, was made Duke of Chu and kept close to the throne, yet was also criticised for the number of great campaigns he had won and was drawn into the silent struggle between Crown Prince Yang Yong and Prince Jin Yang Guang, ending on Guang's side. This pushed the succession toward Guang in practice, and Yang Su died in 606 as the Sui military group broke apart around him. The costs must be recorded too: the wall and the corvée levies weighed on the households of Hebei, and the murmurs of heavy labour and a burdened people were accumulating through the late Kaihuang years, one of the distant causes of the uprisings that closed the Sui. The shape of war in the sixth century also settled here. Infantry remained decisive, cavalry provided movement, pursuit and interdiction, and the fully armoured heavy cavalry of the Sui and Tang was still more than a century away.
result: 打到最後是隋軍得勝。楊素大軍在靈州城下與黃河西岸一線抵住突厥的騎兵攻勢之後，反過來以輕騎斷其退路，步騎合擊，把突厥兵眾趕向西北；追擊的隊伍一直壓到長城以北的斤兩一帶才收兵，途中斬獲數萬，收納降附的部眾與牲畜數以萬計，鐵勒與吐谷渾一帶的部族乘機脫離汗庭。靈州守住之後，隋廷沒有再乘勝深入漠北——糧秣與馬匹的供應撐不住遠征，楊素隨即把重點轉回長城沿線的修築、屯田與軍鎮整頓，北方戰線由攻擊轉為長期守備。勝利並不等於問題解決：仁壽二年之後，突厥仍在開皇末與仁壽年間多次越塞，隋的處境只是由連年大戰變成反覆小戰；真正解決北方問題的，還要等到半個世紀後唐太宗李靖夜襲陰山、貞觀四年（630）擒頡利可汗。從兵器與兵制的角度看，這場戰役則留下了一條清晰的經驗：以重步兵結陣為骨、以精騎為爪、以城屯為根，是隋唐一代在草原方向能夠反覆得手的基本辦法。
resultEn: In the end the Sui won. After Yang Su's main force checked the Turkic horse on the plain below Lingzhou and along the west bank of the Yellow River, light cavalry cut the retreat and foot and horse closed together, driving the Turks north-west. The pursuit was carried as far as the place called Jinliang, north of the wall, before it was called off, taking several tens of thousands in killed and captured, with surrendered communities and livestock counted in ten thousands, while the Tiele and Tuyuhun peoples around the area broke away from the khanate. With Lingzhou held, the Sui court did not push on into the northern desert — grain and horses could not support a distant march — and Yang Su turned at once to the wall line, to garrison farms and to the reform of the frontier towns; the northern front changed from an attacking posture to a long defensive one. The victory did not settle the problem. After 602 the Turks still crossed the frontier several times in the late Kaihuang and Renshou years, and the Sui position only changed from one long war a year into repeated small ones. The northern question was finally settled half a century later, when Li Jing struck the Yin Mountains by night and the Tang took Jieli Khan in 630. In terms of arms and military organisation this campaign left a clear lesson: a dense infantry frame, picked cavalry for the arm, towns and farms for the root — the basic way in which the Sui and the Tang could win again and again on the steppe.
